## Behavior change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and linked issue.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, including pending or skipped tests. Add screenshots for visual changes.

## Deployment and data impact

Describe migrations, configuration, ABI, deployment, and custody or authorization changes. State any required follow-up.

- [ ] No real credentials, private keys, personal records, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Current status and architecture documentation match the behavior.
- [ ] Security-sensitive cases have relevant regression coverage.
